title: Telling a Story
description: Telling a Story: This unattributed concept poster (front) for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK tells part of the film's story through small vignettes, some based on Ralph McQuarrie's paintings. It has a certain photo-realistic and luminous quality. While the trilogy didn't play the Soviet Union on its first run, it came close as this poster (back) from Finland shows. Art by Tom Jung.
